what_changes: Fault-profile FP-L1: worker 2's Fabric A egress keeps the full 100 Mbit link rate but drops 1 percent of packets at random, to measure a pure loss-type gray fault whose TCP behavior differs qualitatively from a rate cap.
expected: Retention degrades through TCP retransmission and congestion response rather than a hard rate ceiling; both interfaces stay up and no recovery claim is made.
